title: Zwap - Piche Dj (Tchoufa Figua Mix)
description:
Label: Barclay
Country: France 🇫🇷
Release: 1992

I have no words to describe this 90's House/Techno beauty, so I'll just put what's written on the back of the sleeve:
"Piche DJ: Nom vulgaire de pichulus doujis doujis.
Genre d'insecte hémipèdre propre aux pays chauds méditerranéens; l'abdomen du mâle porte à la base une sorte de double tambour qui produit des bruits stridents et répétés. C'est un insecte nocturne, remarquable par la facilité avec laquelle il imite la voix humaine. (Ex: un Piche de DJ peut en cacher un autre)."
For those who don't understand french it's talking about an insect that lives in the night and that have a drum instead of a belly, and that imitates human voices easily.
So cheers to those Piche DJ insects and hope you enjoy the ride !

title: Harry Romero - The City (Extended Mix)
description:
Download & stream: https://defect.click/NG117D

From a state steeped in house culture, Harry Romero is one of New Jersey’s finest house exports. Emerging in the mid 1990s and remaining one of the genre’s most in demand producers and remixers to this day, he now debuts on the legendary Nu Groove in the first wave of artists to release music for the new era of the label. Delivering exquisite two tracker ‘I Love / The City’, Harry plays tribute to classics from the Nu Groove catalogue with his modern ‘Choo Choo’ twist he’s loved and revered for. House bubbler ‘I Love’ opens the package with depth and warmth to get you in the mood, while ‘The City’ is a little busier in its composition, a spoken-word vocal telling the familiar tale of house music’s ability to unite, while kinetic percussion and glowy synths make this another striking cut.

description:
"After establishing himself as one of the most promising artists with the inaugural release of the now buy on sight Lobster Theremin imprint, Berlin-based Londoner Palms Trax decamps to Amsterdam institution Dekmantel with the In Gold EP. title: PREMIERE: Clint - Earthchild [SUBMARINE CLUB VOL. 1]
description:
CARGO Recording is a project initiated by the IBOAT’s team in Bordeaux. It supports artists through various tools such as a label, artistic residencies, workshops, publishing, professional accompaniment and visual arts. Submarine Club Vol.1 is the culmination of an artistic project and an accomplished vision of contemporary electronic music. In this first volume, 12 artists deliver their audio definition of the IBOAT Club and submarine dance. 

With previous releases on labels such as Slowciety and Slam City Jams Clint continues his foray into the world of euphoric trance atmospherics ready for any dance floor. Take deep dive into these trancy-house dance groovers!

The release will be a limited 150 copy distributed by Gimme sound and only 50 copies in CD.
